known_mismatch.reason: Accepted deviation (reference/deviations.md, Engine: "Lone CR bytes in the generated PHP"; D2 of research/fuzzing.md (history: git log -- plans/parity-fixes.md)): with debug=true the compiled main class embeds the original source in getSourceContext(); Compiler::string() does not escape its lone CR bytes and PHP counts them as line breaks, while the Compiler counts only LF for getDebugInfo(). Embedded templates (the ___N classes) are compiled after the main class in the same file, so Error::guess() maps their PHP lines to later markers; twig-rs attributes lines by markers and has no PHP line counts.
